lines.text: Men from Judea say circumcision is required for salvation, and Paul and Barnabas are appointed to go to Jerusalem.
They bring great joy through Phoenicia and Samaria, then believers from the Sadducees say Gentiles must be circumcised.
Peter says God gave the Gentiles the Holy Spirit, as He did to us, and cleansed their hearts by faith.
James judges Gentiles turning to God should not be troubled, only told to avoid idol food, immorality, strangled meat, blood.
The church chooses Judas called Barsabbas and Timothy to go to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas, carrying a letter.
